description: Use this when someone asks who their clients are, or needs a client id to look up that person's appointments, payments or quotes. Returns up to 100 clients (20 by default) across all the user's salons, or just one, with id, name, salon and last edit time, in no particular order and without a name search. Not for a client's email, phone or notes.

limit.description: Maximum number of clients to return (default 20, maximum 100)

salonId.description: Only clients of this salon, by an id from the user's salon list; every salon when absent

name: list_clients

clients.description: Clients with the ids needed to look up their bookings, payments and quotes. Email, phone, address, operator notes, service and colour history, organization data and other profile fields are excluded.

title: Look up salon clients
